chunks: From him, from Shādhān ibn al-Khalīl al-Naysābūrī, from Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj, who said:
I asked him about a woman who begins menstruating after the sun has passed the meridian, while she had not performed the ẓuhr prayer: is the make-up of that prayer upon her? He said: "Yes."

key_terms.تَزُولُ الشَّمْسُ: the sun passes the meridian; the beginning of ẓuhr time
key_terms.قَضَاءُ: make-up performance of an obligation after its time

ai.seo_question: If a woman begins menstruating after zawāl and has not yet prayed ẓuhr, must she make up that prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who enters menstruation after the time of ẓuhr has begun but before she has performed the prayer. It states that she must make up that prayer, indicating liability for the salat once its time had entered before the onset of menstruation.
